headlines.title: 【A股温度计】市场估值指标统计：估值指标陷入震荡
headlines.summary:
7月27日，巴菲特指数（沪深300市值/GDP）轻微升至90.23%，接近年内低位；股债性价比指标——沪深300指数股权风险溢价（ERP）回落至5.19%，7月以来基本保持在5.2%附近波动，处于2024年10月以来波动区间下端，暗示目前股市相对国债收益的优势一般。
--------
注：1、巴菲特指数是通过将股市总市值和GDP来比较，判断目前股市是否高估，通常70-100%为正常估值，低于该区间为低估，高于该区间为高估。
2、沪深300指数风险溢价（ERP）主要对比沪深300收益和国债收益率，统计近10年数据可以发现该指标和股

headlines.title_en: 【A-Share Thermometer】Market valuation indicator statistics: Valuation indicators fluctuate
headlines.summary_en:
On July 27, the Buffett Indicator (CSI 300 market cap/GDP) edged up to 90.23%, near its year low; the equity risk premium (ERP) of the CSI 300 fell to 5.19%, hovering around 5.2% since July at the lower end of the range since October 2024, suggesting the advantage of stocks over bonds is average.
--------
Note: 1. The Buffett Indicator compares total stock market cap to GDP to assess overvaluation, with 70-100% as normal, below as undervalued, above as overvalued.
2. The CSI 300 ERP compares CSI 300 returns to government bond yields; decade data shows the indicator correlates with stock.

headlines.title: 中国30年期国债期货创近8个月新高，债市或告别“三低”震荡
headlines.summary: 近日，债市终于摆脱持续的“三低”状态——低成交、低波动、低股债相关性，走出新方向：超长端债券明显走强，7月27日，30年期国债期货主力合约盘中一度升至115.18元，创近8个月新高。多家机构认为，本轮超长债突破，既缘于前期低波动行情积蓄了较强动能，又与基本面偏弱、再通胀预期反复落空、央行呵护资金面，以及机构对超长端期限利差压缩的重新定价有关。不过，在基金久期偏高、政府债供给压力尚未完全落地的背景下，后续行情能否延续，仍取决于配置盘能否接力交易盘。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: China's 30-year treasury bond futures hit near 8-month high; bond market may exit 'three-low' volatility
headlines.summary_en: Recently, the bond market broke out of the persistent 'three lows'—low volume, low volatility, low stock-bond correlation—into a new trend: ultra-long bonds strengthened notably. On July 27, the main 30-year government bond futures contract rose to 115.18 yuan intraday, an eight-month high. Multiple institutions believe this ultra-long bond breakout stems from accumulated momentum in prior low-volatility trades, weak fundamentals, repeated failure of reflation expectations, PBOC liquidity support, and repricing of ultra-long term spread compression. However, with fund duration high and government bond supply pressure not fully digested, the trend's sustainability depends on whether allocation desks can take over from trading desks (Shanghai Securities News).

headlines.title: 31省份上半年GDP出炉：15省份增速跑赢全国，经济大省“挑大梁”作用凸显
headlines.summary: 当前，全国31个省份的经济“半年报”已全部揭晓，其中15个省份的GDP增速跑赢全国平均水平（4.7%）。从经济增速看，西藏GDP增速达6.3%，领跑全国；紧随其后的浙江为5.7%。此外，增速在5.5%以上的省份还有山东、上海、安徽。从经济总量看，前十席位依次为广东、江苏、山东、浙江、四川、河南、湖北、福建、上海、安徽。上述经济十强省份体量合计占全国比重超六成，“挑大梁”作用凸显。其中，广东、江苏上半年突破7万亿元，山东上半年突破5万亿元，安徽重返全国前十。（证券日报）

headlines.title_en: 31 provinces' H1 2026 GDP released: 15 provinces outperform national average; major economic provinces play key supporting role
headlines.summary_en: All 31 provinces have released their H1 economic reports; 15 grew faster than the national average of 4.7%. Tibet led at 6.3%, followed by Zhejiang at 5.7%. Shandong, Shanghai, and Anhui also grew above 5.5%. Top 10 GDP: Guangdong, Jiangsu, Shandong, Zhejiang, Sichuan, Henan, Hubei, Fujian, Shanghai, Anhui. These top 10 accounted for over 60% of national GDP. Guangdong and Jiangsu exceeded 7 trillion yuan, Shandong exceeded 5 trillion yuan, and Anhui returned to the top 10 (Securities Daily).

headlines.summary: 近期，面对全球科技股尤其是半导体板块的剧烈波动，海外基金经理正积极调仓：一方面，多家机构因半导体板块估值高企而减少相关持仓，甚至追加空头头寸；另一方面，资金并未真正离场，而是流入软件、金融、医疗、工业、公用事业等低估值板块，部分投资者更是将目光投向太空经济等前沿领域。尽管对短期板块走势的判断存在较大分歧，但多家机构认为，全球人工智能的长期投资逻辑并未动摇，此轮调整更多是拥挤交易后的估值修复与情绪出清，为新一轮布局打开了窗口。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Adjusting portfolios amid volatility; overseas fund managers engage in long-short 'battles'
headlines.summary_en: Amid sharp global tech stock volatility, especially semiconductors, overseas fund managers are actively rebalancing: some cut semiconductor positions due to high valuations, even adding shorts; funds flow into undervalued sectors like software, finance, healthcare, industrials, utilities, and even frontier areas like space economy. Despite disagreements on short-term sector trends, many believe AI's long-term investment logic remains intact; this adjustment is more about crowded trade unwinding and sentiment clearance, opening a window for new positioning (Shanghai Securities News).

headlines.title: 两家头部券商投诉量占比超25% 中证协通报二季度券商投诉处理情况
headlines.summary: 记者7月28日从业内获悉，中国证券业协会日前在行业内通报了2026年二季度证券公司投诉处理工作情况。一个核心信号是：伴随市场交易活跃度走高，投资者诉求也同步“水涨船高”。数据显示，二季度全行业共接收客户投诉9610件，较一季度环比攀升22.3%；在投诉总量上行的背景下，办结效能仍维持高位，当期累计办结8888件，办结率达92.5%。(中证金牛座)

headlines.title_en: Two top brokerages account for over 25% of complaints; SAC reports Q2 2026 brokerage complaint handling
headlines.summary_en: On July 28, industry sources said the Securities Association of China reported on securities firms' complaint handling in Q2 2026. A key signal: as market activity rose, investor demands also increased. Q2 saw 9,610 complaints industry-wide, up 22.3% from Q1. Despite higher volume, resolution efficiency remained high: 8,888 were resolved, a 92.5% resolution rate (China Securities News Taurus).

headlines.title: 中信建投：A股长期致胜的八个宏观视角
headlines.summary: 中信建投指出，A股市场将长期致胜。当前我国A股的长期趋势是向上的，整体市值是扎实的，投资机遇是广阔的，虽有少数个股泡沫现象，但整体市场没有系统性风险，产业进步和业绩成长显著。而美股全市场系统性泡沫因素极高，虽其仍有科技、货币优势，但全市场产业空心化、价格泡沫化系统性风险不容忽视。相较美股，A股有八个优势。其一，总市值水平不同，为安全边际优势；其二，杠杆规模不同，为流动性条件优势；其三，货币信用不同，为主权信用优势；其四，AI发展模式不同，为AI前景优势；其五，产业更新节奏不同，为向新速度优势；其六，产业链质量不同，为产业链优势；其七，产业实绩不同，为成长

headlines.title_en: CSC: Eight macro perspectives for long-term success in A-shares
headlines.summary_en: CSCI notes A-shares will win long-term. China's A-share market has an upward long-term trend, solid overall market cap, broad investment opportunities; few individual stock bubbles but no systemic risk, with clear industrial progress and earnings growth. US stocks have high systemic bubble risk despite tech and currency advantages; hollowing out and price bubbles pose risks. A-shares have eight advantages: 1. Lower market cap for margin of safety; 2. Different leverage scale for liquidity; 3. Different monetary credit for sovereign credit; 4. Different AI development model for AI prospects; 5. Different industry upgrade pace for speed of innovation; 6. Different supply chain quality for supply chain edge; 7. Different industrial performance for growth.
